tldr: Can the sharp value of an oracle biomarker policy remain stable when an observed outcome cell disappears, even though the feasible assay screen jumps? The proposed answer is a global zero-cost endpoint modulus and a finite-sample whole-set interval, paired with a cost-sensitive boundary family that rules out uniformly vanishing excess width for every interior per-treated cost. The fixed external rectangle and its raw determinant margin are part of the question.
gap: The inspected biomarker, Q-learning thesis, and optimization-inference theorems do not establish the fixed-rectangle binary support-boundary pair. Horowitz–Lee already supplies generic optimization-bound containment; the unverified 2024 journal theorem limits any priority claim.
